mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_registrations(login_id, password_hash, nickname, email, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{loginId} , #{passwordHash} , #{nickname} , #{email} , #{tokenHash} ,#{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select id, login_id as loginId, password_hash as passwordHash, nickname, email, token_hash as tokenHash, expires_at as expiresAt, created_at as createdAt from pending_registrations where token_hash = #{tokenHash}
